toast.cardPayments: {state, select, off {Card payments off — customers pay at the truck} other {Card payments back on}}

banner.cardPaymentsOff: Card payments are off — customers are paying at the truck. This stays off, on every event, until you turn it back on.

settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off during a card problem and customers will place orders as normal and pay at the truck instead. Orders keep coming; only the card step stops.
